name: Nitta Kensuke
source:
The main protagonist of the Sengoku†Koihime series, a student at Franchesca Academy and [url=https://vndb.org/c63854]Kazuto[/url]'s nephew. He serves the Oda Clan as a retainer and general and is assigned the leader of the Kensuke Squad.

[spoiler] He was trained extensively and harshly by Hongou Kazuto's many wives (all the girls from Shin Koihime Musou), and while he isn't a match for them, he is more than skilled enough to make him an above-average warrior in the Sengoku era.[/spoiler]

Kensuke possesses a varied lineup of skills ranging from weaponscraft and tactics to cooking and the making of simple devices like smoke bombs and signal flares.  He is also brave and level-headed, tending to take circumstances as they come without letting them get him down.  He has inherited his uncle's natural philandering ways (though he protests this frequently when others point it out to him), and he gathers women without even realizing he is doing it.
